market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a federal deputy with no significant polling for the presidency. Second place in the first round typically requires a major national candidate; Santos' projected support is negligible. The market's 7.3% implied probability overestimates his chances by a wide margin.
evidence_points: Current polls (mid-2025) show Lula and right-wing figures like Tarcísio de Freitas dominating, with no sign of Renan Santos polling near double digits.
In the 2022 election, the second-place finisher was Jair Bolsonaro with 43%; minor candidates like Tebet got ~4%. Santos has no comparable profile.
Santos is a federal deputy from the PSB, and previous PSB/PSOL candidates have never approached second place in presidential elections.
sources_consulted: Major Brazilian polling aggregators (e.g., Paraná Pesquisas, Datafolha) showing Lula vs. potential right-wing candidates
